result.prompt:
Copy the following passage exactly, without commentary:

The old observatory stood above the harbor. Every evening, Mira checked the brass telescope, wrote the wind direction in her notebook, and counted the lights of ships returning home. On Tuesday she found a blue envelope beside the door. Inside was a map of the northern coast and a short message: follow the river until you reach the stone bridge, then wait for sunrise. The next morning, she packed a compass, two apples, and a wool scarf. The path crossed a meadow where the grass was silver with dew. Near the river, an abandoned watermill creaked in the breeze. Mira stopped to sketch its broken wheel, then continued upstream. At the bridge she met a fisherman repairing his net. He pointed toward a small cabin on the hillside and said that the mapmaker had been expecting her for several days.

matched_prompt_comparison.caveat: Automatic RAM cache budgets varied with background memory; this is a combined configuration comparison, not isolated attribution.

verification.lookup: Longest suffix and bounds checked; hybrid lookup source restricted to verified input
verification.real_expert_outputs: Four-reader cache hit and eviction oracle: exact CUDA outputs
verification.memory_pressure: Backing storage freed; reloaded computation identical
verification.generated_python: Syntax and function signature only; never executed
verification.speculative_tokens: Every MTP/lookup proposal checked by full target model before output

selected_changes: MTP8 + prompt lookup up to 128 tokens; hybrid bootstrap from verified input
Bounded dynamic LFU expert cache in RAM and priority caching of MTP nonexpert matrices in GPU
Two direct SSD read workers; larger worker counts measured slower
Official chat template rendered without redundant full tokenizer
Memory pressure guards: RAM reserve 1.25 GiB, dynamic GPU reserve 0.125 GiB
unsuccessful_experiments: MTP16 and growing MTP32: did not improve ordinary tasks consistently; default remains 8
Fully resident MTP occupied 4.695 GiB and displaced useful target weights; math slower
Four/eight SSD readers slower than two
Short suffix lookup produced costly incorrect proposals; require at least eight matching tokens
GPU reserves 1.8 and 0.5 GiB evicted useful target cache; lowered to 0.125 GiB
One count run had unexplained long pauses and achieved 0.115 tok/s; retained without asserting a proven cause or cure
limitations: Universal 1 tok/s not reached. Above 1 tok/s measured for exact copying of existing prompt text only.
Ordinary new code around 0.21 tok/s; short arithmetic around 0.39 tok/s in development tests.
Generation rate excludes prompt processing; includes control tokens and EOS computation, while EOS itself is excluded from token count.
Large verified blocks can delay first displayed token for minutes; inspect TTFT and total time.
Results are individual exploratory runs, not statistical guarantees; RAM cache budgets and background load vary.
CUDA rounding may differ by verification batch size; exact token equality is checked for listed cases, not guaranteed for all prompts.
Reader wait durations overlap between threads and must not be treated as wall-clock IO time.
